name: 53559 · Marshall, WI
findings: ZIP 53559 (Marshall) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53559 (Marshall) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53559 (Marshall) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
